caveats: Experimental. A simple terrain fill: ignores channel flow, walls, drains, pumps and defences. Ensemble frequency, not a verified flood probability.

One flat water level for the whole area, from the New Botley gauge (1645TH) plus its stage datum 54.00 mAOD (EA station metadata, about ±0.05 m); it ignores the river's slope and the drop at Osney Lock, so it overstates water east of the lock.
Terrain: EA LIDAR Composite DTM 2022 1 m (OGL v3), via the Defra DSP WCS, resampled to 5 m. River cells: EA Statutory Main River Map (OGL v3).
200 runs per frame: forecast level drawn from the River Clock quantiles; terrain perturbed by ±0.15 m smoothed noise for LiDAR error.
Shading: 25 m squares coloured by the average share of runs in which their 5 m cells are wet: green from 5%, yellow at 50%, red at 100%; clear below 5%. River centreline cells are left out.
Largest extent wet in at least half the runs, over these frames: 1 ha of the 250 ha box, not counting the mapped river centrelines.
